summary.text: Mitch Boggs is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House District 157 since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Boggs, also known as Mitchie, is a general contractor and farmer.

paragraphs.text: Mitch Boggs was born in Lawrence County, Missouri.
His career experience includes working as a general contractor and farmer and owning a construction business.
Boggs took office on January 6, 2021, succeeding Mike Moon.
For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists him on the Budget, Conservation and Natural Resources and Transportation committees.
